propositions: Enable Jira Cloud rich-text reconciliation by setting reconciler.rich_text_cutover to 'cloud' in the project rebar.toml configuration

The legacy plain-wire golden test must explicitly override the reconciler.rich_text_cutover setting to 'off' via environment variable before constructing its backend fixture to preserve its historical plain-form expectations
The test_canonical_outbound_equivalence.py fixture requires function scope and monkeypatch to set REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER environment variable without inheriting project operational config
The markdown-to-ADF bridge behavior is already shipped and tested and should be enabled for Jira Cloud without affecting Data Center deployments
Configuration validation must be verified through rebar config command and ensure no whitespace errors or lint/typecheck regressions
